reading.workResult: Fail-closed admission passed for branch main, wake source chatgpt-scheduled-task, the active 2026-08-26 Reading window and the worker's available GitHub read/write, file-editing and primary-source research capabilities. The unique Reading Wake Receipt was committed and fetched before Runtime business work. Global serial reconciliation found Discovery and Queue closed and Reading as the earliest due unfinished task; the repository scheduler durably opened Reading at 11:05:32 and the native claim workflow persisted Worker Claimed at 11:07:34 before substantive Deep Reading. Skill 03 then completed primary-source reading for all three same-day P0 objects and produced exactly three durable Reading Notes. Q-20260826-01 verifies Google ADK Workflow terminal-truth handling for detached dynamic nodes: in-flight tracked detached work is awaited after static graph completion; a child error or raised exception fails the enclosing workflow, and a detached interrupt is converted to an error because that execution form cannot be resumed. The explicit limitation is that cancelled tasks are skipped and detached runs already finished before graph-end inspection cannot be distinguished from awaited/handled runs. Q-20260826-02 verifies OpenAI Codex MCP attachment-owned authority: enabled servers receive explicit per-server PermissionProfiles when a runtime is published, unresolved authority prevents MCP call preparation, and approval, elicitation and sandbox-sensitive behavior reuses server-owned authority including across demonstrated refresh paths; this does not prove universal revocation for already-prepared calls. Q-20260826-03 verifies Google ADK copy-on-mutation isolation for RunConfig HTTP options: request-mutable containers and retry options are copied per invocation while caller-supplied live HTTP clients remain shared by reference, avoiding non-copyable-client crashes and demonstrated caller-container write-through; nested mutable values and shared-client internal state are outside the demonstrated guarantee. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication and used no prior-day Runtime artifact as a business input.
reading.workResult_zh: 针对 main 分支、chatgpt-scheduled-task 唤醒源、2026-08-26 有效 Reading 时段，以及当前 Worker 实际具备的 GitHub 读写、文件编辑与一手来源研究能力，Fail-Closed Admission 通过。任何 Runtime 业务工作前，唯一 Reading Wake Receipt 已提交并重新 Fetch 核验。全局串行 Reconciliation 确认 Discovery 与 Queue 已收口，Reading 是最早到期未收口任务；仓库 Scheduler 于 11:05:32 持久打开 Reading 执行槽，原生 Claim Workflow 于 11:07:34 持久写入 Worker Claimed，之后才开始实质 Deep Reading。随后 Skill 03 对当天三个 P0 对象全部完成一手来源深读，并恰好生成三份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260826-01 核验 Google ADK Workflow 的 Detached Dynamic Node 终态真值：Static Graph 完成后仍在飞行且被跟踪的 Detached Work 会被等待；Child Error 或 Task Raised Exception 会使所属 Workflow 失败，而 Detached Interrupt 因该执行形态不可恢复而被转换为 Error。明确边界是 Cancelled Task 被跳过，且在 Graph-end Inspection 前已经结束的 Detached Run 无法与已 Await/Handled Run 区分。Q-20260826-02 核验 OpenAI Codex MCP 的 Attachment-owned Authority：Runtime 发布时为 Enabled Server 建立显式 Per-server PermissionProfile，Authority 无法解析时拒绝准备 MCP Call，Approval、Elicitation 与 Sandbox-sensitive 行为复用 Server-owned Authority，并覆盖已展示的 Refresh 路径；但这不能证明对已准备 Call 的普遍即时撤权。Q-20260826-03 核验 Google ADK 对 RunConfig HTTP Option 的 Copy-on-Mutation 隔离：每次 Invocation 复制可被请求修改的 Container 与 Retry Option，而 Caller 提供的 Live HTTP Client 继续按引用共享，从而避免不可复制 Client 导致的 Crash，并阻止已展示的 Caller-container Write-through；Nested Mutable Value 与 Shared Client 自身内部状态不在该保证范围。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication，也未把前一日 Runtime Artifact 作为业务输入。

researchObjects.judgment: Detached work should remain part of parent workflow terminal truth until it either reaches a terminal state under the parent or is explicitly transferred to another governed owner. A foreground return, spawn acknowledgement or background label is not terminal evidence. The demonstrated pattern is stable detached-action identity, owned lifecycle registration and a parent terminal barrier, not distributed exactly-once execution or remote-effect certainty.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Detached Work 应持续参与 Parent Workflow 的 Terminal Truth，直到它在 Parent 名下达到终态，或被显式转移给另一个受治理 Owner。Foreground Return、Spawn Acknowledgement 或 Background Label 都不是 Terminal Evidence。已证明模式是稳定 Detached-action Identity、Owned Lifecycle Registration 与 Parent Terminal Barrier，而不是分布式 Exactly-once Execution 或 Remote-effect Certainty。

researchObjects.judgment: Authority-bearing permission and connected-tool state should be owned at the same lifecycle scope as the attachment/runtime occurrence it governs. A refresh or authorization completion in one runtime should not replace authoritative state for unrelated attachments. Per-session ownership narrows replacement blast radius but does not prove distributed consistency, durable authorization state, universal race freedom or exactly-once transitions.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 携带 Authority 的 Permission 与 Connected-tool State 应由其所治理的 Attachment/Runtime Occurrence 同一 Lifecycle Scope 拥有。一个 Runtime 的 Refresh 或 Authorization Completion 不应替换无关 Attachment 的权威状态。Per-session Ownership 缩小 Replacement Blast Radius，但不能证明分布式一致性、Durable Authorization State、通用 Race Freedom 或 Exactly-once Transition。

researchObjects.judgment: Reusable clients should treat templated mutable request options as read-mostly baseline state and create an invocation-owned copy before per-call enrichment. This prevents top-level option aliasing across calls while allowing intentionally shared live client/transport objects to remain shared under separate controls. The evidence does not prove deep isolation, cookie/session isolation, custom-client safety or generic concurrency correctness.
